Our Venue

Space to gather. Room to celebrate.

SK Convention Center brings together the essentials for memorable occasions: a 600-seat fully air-conditioned auditorium, dining for up to 800 people at a time, parking for 250 cars, generator facility and a prayer hall.

With more than 500 weddings celebrated here, we focus on the spaces and facilities that help your occasion come together smoothly.
